Iris: Micro-trifecta poll 1: pick a snack for Friday standup lunch (react or reply)
  a) :sandwich: Sandwiches
  b) :salad: Salad bowls
  c) :ramen: Noodle boxes
  d) :croissant: Pastries

Noel: :sandwich: Sandwiches please. easy to share.

Asha: :ramen: Noodle boxes for me. comfort food.

Tom: :croissant: Croissants! morning sugar boost.

Gabe: quick second poll 1: editor showdown for Saturday pairing (one-word replies): vscode / helix / neovim / sublime

Iris: and third tiny thing 1: new micro-model codename. options: `Nim`, `Byte`, `Peanut`, `Spark` 1 react or write-in.

Noel: votes: Sandwiches, neovim, Nim 

Asha: Salad bowls, helix, Peanut (i like the irony)

Tom: Croissants, vscode, Spark (speed vibes)

Gabe: Sandwiches, sublime, Byte (short and nerdy)

poll-bot: Polls closed (30m). Results:
  Snacks: Sandwiches 2, Salad bowls 1, Noodle boxes 1, Pastries 1
  Editors: vscode 1, helix 1, neovim 1, sublime 1 (tie)
  Codenames: Nim 1, Peanut 1, Spark 1, Byte 1 (four-way tie)

Iris: lol massive tie energy. I'll DM for dietary prefs and we can randomize the codename draw + run a 5-min tiebreaker in-thread later. Thanks for the votes :sparkles:
